name: XLE_JURISDICTIONS_B
description: XLE_JURISDICTIONS contains the information about Jurisdictions.

columns.name: JURISDICTION_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier of the jurisdiction.

columns.name: JURISDICTION_CODE
columns.description: Alternate key that is used to identify each jurisdiction uniquely.

columns.name: LEGISLATIVE_CAT_CODE
columns.description: Legislative category (Labor Law, Transactions Tax Law, and Income Tax Laws) used to identify the type of law associated with a given registration. A legal entity or a legal reporting unit can have many registrations with many legal authorities for different purposes.

columns.name: GEOGRAPHY_ID
columns.description: Region or district assigned to a representative, agent, or the like, as for making sales.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_CODE_LE
columns.description: Registration code used for legal entity.

columns.name: REGISTRATION_CODE_ETB
columns.description: Registration code used for establishment.

columns.name: IDENTIFYING_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag for Identifying jurisdiction for legal entities.

columns.name: REQUIRED_LE_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag for defaulting associated registration code during legal entities creation.

columns.name: REQUIRED_ETB_FLAG
columns.description: Yes or No flag for defaulting associated registration code during establishments creation.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_FROM
columns.description: Date on which a task, event or business process begins. Use for date enabled entities for which histories are not stored.

columns.name: EFFECTIVE_TO
columns.description: Date that a task, event, or business process ends. Use for date enabled entities that histories are not stored for.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
